intent: Bounded Backfill Reorder Window: windowTimeout(bufferCapacity, reorderWindow) then sorts each window by tDevice and re-emits; never unbounded collectList. A sample emitted at a position different from its arrival counts telemetry.backfill.reordered. Window and capacity come from externalized config via constructor. observability.step_logs: ["backfill-reordered"].

methods.signature: BackfillReorderer(Duration reorderWindow, int bufferCapacity, TelemetryMetrics metrics)
